 DAYTON, Ohio (WKEF) -- The Medicare annual enrollment period is underway, and there's still time to review your coverage before the December 7 deadline. 
 From understanding plan costs to making sure your doctors and prescriptions are covered, choosing the right plan can feel very overwhelming. 
 So, Jim Spalding from Miami Valley Medicare & Retirement Solutions joined Good Day Dayton to share some advice for those going through the process.
